=== STORY-1129 CI-RED DIAGNOSIS (product/overseer) — REAL regression, not flaky ===
PR #1844 Build (ubuntu-latest) failed: `-p aida-cli-lib --lib` exit 101.
Failing test: init_cmd::task_510_init_scaffold_task_tests::post_init_hooks_run_executable_sh_files_in_lexical_order_with_context
Panic: init_cmd.rs:2292 `assert_eq!(lines.next(), Some("2"))` — the 2nd post-init hook did not append "2" (hook order/set changed).

Root cause: STORY-1129 threads a new `with_mcp: bool` through the init/hook scaffold path (init_cmd.rs run_post_init_hooks_from_dir signature, config_cmd.rs apply_to_scaffold_config(&mut config, with_mcp)). That plumbing altered which post-init hooks run or their lexical order, breaking this test.

Action for the STORY-1129 re-drive: this is a CODE fix (or a deliberate-behavior test update), NOT a CI re-run — re-running CI on the same SHA will fail identically. Either (a) the with_mcp threading unintentionally changed the scaffolded hook set/order — fix the plumbing so post-init hooks are unaffected by the MCP flag; or (b) if the hook-set change is intended, update the test expectation. Also check no OTHER test asserted MCP-registered-by-default (per ADR-30 acceptance, those need updating to the opt-in default too).

Everything else this round looks good: the 4 re-drives (BUG-1155/STORY-1125/BUG-1157/BUG-1156) all COMPLETED; BUG-1156 done unblocks TASK-1236. — product/overseer
